## Evidence policy

Client-result figures are labelled by what they represent. Pipeline, channelled property value, leads, booked sales, realized revenue, and Shreyas OS company revenue are not treated as interchangeable. Founder/client-case reports are disclosed as such when independent audit evidence is not public.
